mapper.sql: p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.cur_cntrct_amt,p.init_cntrct_amt, p.trgt_cst_amt,p.trgt_mrgn_rt,p.cur_end_dt,d.dev_nm AS owner_name, (SELECT w.actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY w.wrt_dt DESC,w.memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS progress_rt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}

SELECT d.dev_id,d.dev_nm,c.indv_lbr_cst_amt AS monthly_cost_amt, (SELECT sum(m.mm_qty) FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l JOIN prj.tk_aloc_mth m ON m.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id WHERE l.prj_id=#{id} AND l.dev_id=d.dev_id AND l.line_ty_cd='PERSON' AND l.aloc_stg_cd=(SELECT s.aloc_stg_cd FROM prj.tk_aloc_line s WHERE s.prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY CASE s.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1) AND m.aloc_ym > #{throughMonth}) AS future_mm_qty FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM cst.mth_cst s WHERE s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym <= #{throughMonth} AND s.duty_se_cd='DIRECT' ORDER BY s.cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l WHERE l.prj_id=#{id} AND l.dev_id=d.dev_id AND l.line_ty_cd='PERSON') ORDER BY d.dev_id

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < to_date(#{throughMonth},'YYYY-MM') + interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= to_date(#{throughMonth},'YYYY-MM')
SELECT s.num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std s WHERE s.oprt_std_id=#{key} AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY s.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
